newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica current acct gap maximum 5 bln rand in '97.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica current acct gap maximum 5 bln rand in '97.

text.p: South African Reserve Bank Governor Chris Stals told reporters on Tuesday that he expected the current account deficit to narrow to between one and five billion rand this year.
"Five billion is the maximum," Stals said.
He said current estimates suggested the current account deficit was around eight billion rand in 1996, down from 10 billion rand in 1995.
South Africa could expect to see some 10 billion rand of capital inflows in 1997 against 4.5 billion rand in 1996.
However, Stals cautioned that a lot of this would be short-term funds which could easily leave the country again.
